sources.caveat: Only the 132 genes flagged 'in TelNet' in the article's pan-cancer supplement (Table S1) are used, not the full 2000+ gene TelNet database (its website is no longer served). Score 1-10 is the TelNet telomere-maintenance significance score; it is curated literature evidence, not a result of this screen.
sources.name: TelNet telomere-maintenance genes (pan-cancer supplement)

sources.attribution: NHGRI-EBI GWAS Catalog (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/); study accession and PubMed ID given per gene. Cite the current GWAS Catalog publication listed at https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gwas/docs/about and the original studies. Identifiers bridged via the HGNC complete set (CC0, retrieved 2026-09-30; genenames.org, Seal et al. NAR 2023).
sources.caveat: A GWAS locus-to-gene mapping is an association of a lead variant with telomere length, NOT a causal gene assignment: mapped genes are the gene overlapping the variant or, for intergenic variants, the flanking genes. Only associations with p <= 5e-8 are kept. Genes are joined by gene symbol (the API returns no Ensembl IDs).

sources.caveat: Common-essential means most cancer cell lines need the gene for proliferation in CRISPR knockout screens; siRNA knockdown of such genes may reduce cell numbers and confound per-cell foci readouts. It says nothing about telomeres by itself.
